description:
Stop the gate definition and evaluation tests in `crates/jit/tests/cli_gate` reading ids or values from human-readable output.

## Background

Shared test support provides one CLI process fixture, which reads the ids of issues it creates from `--json` output. These files still parse human-readable output with `split_whitespace`, mostly to scrape created ids. This entry covers `gate_cli_integration_test.rs`, `gate_modification_cli_tests.rs`, `nested_checker_recovery_test.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No test in these files reads an id or other value from human-readable output; ids and values come from `--json` output.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each edited test asserts the property it asserted before and passes alone, in any order and in parallel.
title: gate definition and evaluation tests read created ids from JSON output
